title: Psalm 96 (O Sing Unto The Lord)
lyrics_original: O sing unto the LORD a new song:
Sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
Sing unto the LORD, bless His name;
Show forth His salvation from day to day.
Declare His glory among the heathen,
He is to be feared above all gods.
O sing unto the LORD a new song:
Sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
Sing unto the LORD, bless His name;
Show forth His salvation from day to day.
Declare His glory among the heathen,
He is to be feared above all gods.
He is to be feared above all gods.

bible_verses.english: Oh sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth. Sing to Yahweh, bless his name. Proclaim his salvation from day to day. Declare his glory among the nations, his wonders among all peoples.

Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable. One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts. I will meditate on the glorious splendor of your majesty, and on your wondrous works.
Oh give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make known his deeds among the peoples. Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, You are great and worthy of all praise, far above anything this world offers. Fill my heart today with a fresh song of gratitude for Your salvation and daily wonders. Help me to boldly share Your goodness and glory with those around me through both my words and my life. May my praise honor You today and draw others to Your amazing love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, You are great and worthy of all praise, far above anything this world offers. devotional.reflection_english: Every new day brings fresh reasons to sing of God's unchanging goodness and marvelous works. Psalm 96 invites us to look beyond our immediate circumstances and lift our voices in praise alongside all of creation. As we declare His salvation daily, our worship becomes a glowing witness to a world searching for true hope. May our hearts be renewed today as we magnify the Lord, who alone is worthy of all glory and honor.
